name: Mouse Flair Trail
description: Full-screen cursor effect where icons pop in with an elastic scale and random spin at the pointer as it moves, then fall off the bottom of the screen in a rotating trail.
contents: Pool of flair images that cycle along the cursor path
behavior: Each time the pointer travels past the gap distance, the next image pops in at the pointer with elastic scale and random rotation
Images then fall downward with a back-in ease and are recycled
Tracks pointer movement, so touch dragging also spawns flair
GSAP is loaded by dynamic import and ticker, listener and tweens are cleaned up on unmount
editableByProps: Prompt text, background and text colors
Flair images, size, spawn spacing, pop and fall easing, fall distance and rotation range
fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Flair images use fixed positioning and a window pointermove listener, removed on unmount
